TEXAS FUGITIVE ARRESTED IN ARIZONA!

In Kingman, AZ, USBP agents apprehended a Mexican national illegally present in the U.S.- wanted in Kerrville, TX for online solicitation of a child for sexual conduct. Even more disturbing he was traveling with a family that included two minor children. He was turned over to local police to execute the warrant and extradite him. An immigration detainer has also been placed. 

Working diligently to keep sexual predators off our streets.

tweets.text:
A SMUGGLER & HIS SHOTGUN RIDER!
In Brownsville, TX, USBP agents dismantled a human smuggling scheme after spotting a suspicious Dodge Neon with a La Santa Muerte statue, a trinket smugglers often idolize for "protection." The driver ignored agents, slammed into a utility trailer, and bailed into the nearby brush with his two passengers. Agents quickly apprehended the passengers, while the driver got away- but not for long. He was located and arrested a couple of days later.
 
Here are their consequences: 
▪️Driver- Mexican national, prosecution for alien smuggling
▪️Passenger 1- Mexican national, prosecution felony for illegal re-entry
▪️Passenger 2 - Mexican national, charged as an Inadmissible alien
 
Smugglers make note- not even La Santa Muerte can protect you from USBP.
